value.description: The Roland V-Stage 88 is a professional stage keyboard designed for expressive performance. With 88 weighted keys, it provides a realistic piano feel, while Roland's advanced sound engine delivers a wide range of high-quality instrument sounds suitable for any musical genre.
value.description_short: A professional 88-key stage keyboard with realistic piano feel and versatile sounds.

specs.effects: Reverb, Chorus, Modulation, etc. (details vary by model)

features: 88 weighted keys for authentic piano touch
High-quality instrument sounds for versatile performance
MIDI and USB connectivity for integration with other devices
Compact and lightweight design for portability
Built-in speakers (if applicable, varies by model)
cons: May lack advanced features found in higher-end models
Onboard speakers may not be sufficient for all venues (if applicable)
